info.title: Interf Local Service API
info.summary: Human-readable contract for the Interf local service.
info.description: Interf prepares data for agents. This OpenAPI document describes the local service API that the CLI, MCP, and authorized clients use.

get.description: Small tokenless liveness probe for local clients.
Return local service metadata without Project or Source contents.
Return the generated OpenAPI document for the local service API.
Return Projects registered on this instance with Source bindings, intent, Build Plan selection, and Context Graph locators.

post.description: Create a Project bound to one Source and one agent task intent. Project ids may be generated by clients.

get.description: Read one Project to confirm its Source binding, selected Build Plan, readiness, and latest Context Graph.

post.description: Draft a Build Plan from the Project intent, requested outputs, and coverage expectations. This does not run a Build.
Run the selected Build Plan and create an isolated Context Graph folder. Use only after Build Plan approval or explicit autonomy.

get.description: Read compact Run observability for polling. Detailed logs and artifacts are separate resources.
Read the bounded artifact manifest for a finished Build run. Use only when the compact status says the Run is terminal.

Read the durable event log for a Build run: stage start/pass/fail, files processed, artifacts written, evidence, checks, and readiness. Use compact status for polling; read events to inspect or replay what happened.
Read a prompt log, status log, event stream, stage contract, or evidence file from the exact Build run output. Use this instead of latest Context Graph file reads when debugging historical runs.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Relative file path inside the Build run's Context Graph output.

get.description: Return the latest successful Context Graph locator, GraphManifest, primary metrics, StageManifest summaries, entrypoints, and ready/not ready rollup for a Project.
Return StageManifest summaries for the latest Context Graph.
Return the ResourceRef index from the latest GraphManifest.
Return replayable per-stage execution shell sessions for the latest Build run, including workspace, prompt, logs, validation attempts, and stage contract paths.
Return one ResourceRef from the latest GraphManifest for inspector drilldown.

parameters.name: resource_id
parameters.description: ResourceRef id from the latest Context Graph manifest.

get.description: Return one replayable stage execution shell session for inspector drilldown.

parameters.name: stage_run_id
parameters.description: Stage execution session id from the latest Build run.

get.description: Read the ready/not ready verdict for the latest Context Graph against the Project intent.
Return the latest Source Manifest projected as source file rows for compatibility clients. Use source-manifest as the canonical run authority.
Return the evidence-backed Source Manifest recorded for the latest Context Graph.
Return the primary downstream entrypoint for the latest Context Graph. Agents should start from home.md.
Read one file from the latest Context Graph by relative path. Start with home.md; use knowledge/ for task-specific notes and summaries/ for source-backed coverage.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Relative file path inside the latest Context Graph.

get.description: Read source-backed trace rollups for exact values and provenance checks.
Read supplemental diagnostic rows for the latest Context Graph. GraphManifest primary metrics are the authoritative coverage summary.

bearerAuth.description: Per-instance bearer token for local service clients.
